_comment: Golden vectors for the #629 codec primitives. The TypeScript and Python codecs each assert their own encoding against THIS file rather than against each other, so byte-identity is held by a committed third party instead of one side trusting the other. -20 and 20 are the #524 chart cell envelope's extremes (CHART_CELL_CAP); the two largest entries are botWireMaxSafeSignedInteger / bot_wire_max_safe_signed_integer.
